name: agent-payment-mcp
description: USDC pay-per-call billing for AI agents. v2 non-custodial mode confirmed registration-exempt by Japan FSA (Q11, 2026-05-21) — your USDC stays in your own wallet. ERC-2612 permit replaces JWT-style Pay Tokens. Demo Mode works with zero signup.

LEMON_CAKE_PERMIT.description: ERC-2612 permit blob from lemoncake.xyz/start/v2. New v2 non-custodial path (FSA Q11 confirmed). Recommended.

LEMON_CAKE_PAY_TOKEN.description: Legacy Pay Token JWT from lemoncake.xyz/start. Custody mode — use v2 (LEMON_CAKE_PERMIT) instead.

LEMON_CAKE_BUYER_JWT.description: Buyer session JWT for balance lookups in legacy mode. Optional in Demo Mode.
